title: Pseudo Selector
body:
Matches on state or position rather than on anything written in the [[HTML]]. Written with a
colon.

```css
a:hover        { ... }   /* while the pointer is over it */
input:focus    { ... }   /* while it has keyboard focus */
li:nth-child(2){ ... }   /* the second child */
p:first-child  { ... }
```

The state ones are the reason hover effects need no JavaScript. Note the related but different
*pseudo-element* syntax with two colons (`::before`, `::after`), which invents content rather
than selecting existing content. See [[CSS Selectors]].
